title: Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Cloud Browser

blocks.text: This guide takes you step by step through the configuration tasks you must complete to use the Cloud Browser for Zero Trust Browser (formerly Zscaler Isolation) for your organization. The steps reflect the process for configuring Cloud Browser for either Internet & SaaS (ZIA) or Private Access (ZPA). To learn more, see Understanding the Zscaler Cloud Architecture for Internet & SaaS and What Is Zscaler Private Access?
Before you use Cloud Browser, Zscaler recommends reading the following articles:

blocks.item: Understanding Cloud Browser
Ranges & Limitations

blocks.text: Before you configure Cloud Browser, make sure you have:

blocks.item: Access to an Internet & SaaS or a Private Access tenant.
A subscription to Zero Trust Browser.
Supporting Private Access infrastructure (e.g., App Connector or Application Access).
An identity provider (IdP) with conditional access capabilities (e.g., IP restrictions or context-aware policy).

blocks.text: To configure Cloud Browser, complete the following steps:

blocks.item: Step 1: Enable Cloud Browser for Your Organization
To enable Cloud Browser for your organization:
Enable Internet & SaaS for your organization.
Enable Private Access for your organization.
Contact Zscaler Support to get Cloud Browser enabled for your organization.
Step 2: Create Isolation Profiles
Create isolation profiles for different users of your tenant:
For Internet & SaaS isolation profiles:
Create an Internet & SaaS isolation profile. You can edit your isolation profiles at any time.
Choose banner themes for the isolation end user notification that appears for each isolation profile.
Choose the root certificates for each isolation profile.
For Private Access isolation profiles:
Create a Private Access isolation profile. You can edit your isolation profiles at any time.
Choose banner themes for the isolation end user notification that appears for each isolation profile.
Choose the root certificates for each isolation profile.
Step 3: Configure Policies for Cloud Browser
Configure policies to map to the isolation profiles:
For Internet & SaaS policies:
Configure Internet & SaaS for Cloud Browser.
Configure the cloud app control policy.
Configure the Smart Browser Isolation policy.
Configure the Sandbox integration with Cloud Browser.
For Private Access policies:
Learn about the isolation policy.
Configure isolation policies.
Configure the access policy for Cloud Browser.
Configure secure SaaS access from unmanaged devices via the User Portal.
